title: Rider Bundle Discount for Real Estate Orders Carrying an Add-On
content:
**Discount rule.** A reissued plan invoice on a Real Estate Service Contracts order receives a rider bundle discount when the order itself carries a Bridgewell rider from the Optional Coverage Add-Ons in status waiting period or active. The discount follows the rider premium billed on that rider:

| Rider on this order | Rider premium billed on that rider | Rider bundle discount |
|---|---|---|
| in status waiting period or active | $150.00 or more | $60.00 |
| in status waiting period or active | above zero but below $150.00 | $30.00 |
| no such rider on the order, or nothing billed on it | — | no rider bundle discount |

The discount is a flat amount subtracted once from the reissued plan premium; the reissued plan premium is never below zero.

## Records read

From the Optional Coverage Add-Ons records: the rider attached to this real estate order, its status, and the premium charges billed on that rider.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical orders)

- A rider in its waiting period attached to the order, with $149.99 of rider premium billed: $30.00.
- An active rider attached to the order, with $150.00 billed: $60.00.
- A rider attached to the buyer's homeowner contract rather than to this order: not a rider this order carries; no discount.
- A rider on the order in any status other than waiting period or active: no discount.
